==Description==
'''Healthy Enemies''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Broke]] and before [[Speedy Enemies]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match.

==Effects==
When applied, enemies will gain [[Bloated]], doubling their health.

==Trivia==
*'''Healthy Enemies''' is a slightly modernized version of the [[Juggernaut (Modifier)|Juggernaut]] modifier, acting as the [[Challenge Trials]] replacement for it.
